I don't actually have write/push/merge tools available in this session (only file-reading tools), so I can't merge this myself — you'll need to do that through GitHub/your normal flow. A couple of things worth flagging before it goes out, though:

1. **"SOC 2 Type II certified" is technically inaccurate wording**, and making it *more prominent* is exactly the wrong moment to leave that as-is. SOC 2 isn't a certification (like ISO 27001 is) — it's an auditor's attestation report. Precise language is usually "SOC 2 Type II compliant," "SOC 2 Type II audited," or "we maintain a SOC 2 Type II report." Given the whole reason for this change is a competitor getting called out for overstating their security posture, shipping imprecise terminology in bigger, bolder text is the kind of thing that invites the same scrutiny onto you. Worth a 30-second check with whoever manages your compliance/audit relationship (or legal) on the exact wording before it's more visible.

2. Separate from wording — I'd still want to actually see the diff and the file it's in before treating this as a rubber-stamp merge. Even a 3-line JSX change can have a typo, a broken link to the report/trust page, or an accessibility issue (e.g., missing alt text if a badge/icon is involved).

Can you paste the diff or the file path? I can review it and point out anything worth fixing, then you (or whoever has merge rights) can ship it in time for tomorrow.
